name: Receptor Address Detail
description:
# Retrieve a Receptor Address:

Make GET request to this resource to retrieve a single receptor address
record containing the following fields:

* `id`: Database ID for this receptor address. (integer)
* `url`: URL for this receptor address. (string)
* `address`: Routable address for this instance. (string)
* `port`: Port for the address. (integer)
* `protocol`: Protocol to use for the Receptor listener, 'tcp', 'wss', or 'ws'. (choice)
    - `tcp`: TCP
    - `ws`: WS
    - `wss`: WSS
* `websocket_path`: Websocket path. (string)
* `is_internal`: If True, only routable within the Kubernetes cluster. (boolean)
* `canonical`: If True, this address is the canonical address for the instance. (boolean)
* `instance`:  (id)
* `peers_from_control_nodes`: If True, control plane cluster nodes should automatically peer to it. (boolean)
* `full_address`:  (field)
